Lily hopes to visit London one day. Lily thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the birthday party. Best of all, what a nice surprise to see you!
Lily bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Lily drinks milk after doing sports. Both of them like salad and milk. Best of all, please offer your seat to elderly passengers.
Anna is interested in drawing. There are always many people at the birthday party. Lily and Anna had great fun there. A library card opens every branch.
Last Wednesday, Lily and Anna went to the game corner. The weather was sunny that day. Lily plays baseball with Anna every Wednesday.
